about.heading: Who we are
about.description: ACM NMIET is the student chapter of the Association for Computing Machinery, the world's largest computing society. We bring together curious minds, creative thinkers and problem solvers to build a stronger tech community on campus.

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.text: To empower students with technology, creativity and leadership skills, and create opportunities for meaningful learning and real-world impact.
mission.quote: Technology is not just about machines, it's about people.

focusAreas.title: Our Focus Areas
focusAreas.subtitle: Explore the diverse technical domains where we learn, build, and grow together. We focus on practical skills that bridge the gap between academia and industry.
focusAreas.sectionDescription: At ACM NMIET, we don't just talk about technology; we dive deep. From building scalable applications to securing digital infrastructures, our focus areas cover the most vital skills in today's tech landscape.

domains.title: Web & App Dev
domains.description: Building responsive websites and cross-platform mobile applications using modern frameworks and best practices.

domains.title: AI & Machine Learning
domains.description: Exploring the frontiers of intelligence, training data models, and implementing predictive algorithms to solve real problems.

domains.title: Competitive Coding
domains.description: Mastering algorithms and data structures to efficiently solve complex coding challenges and excel in competitions.

domains.title: Cybersecurity
domains.description: Learning to protect systems, networks, and programs from digital attacks through ethical hacking and defense strategies.

domains.title: UI/UX & Design
domains.description: Designing intuitive, accessible, and aesthetically pleasing user interfaces and seamless user experiences.

domains.title: Data Science
domains.description: Unlocking actionable insights from raw data to drive decision-making and business innovation through analytics.
